history_count_note: Three unique attribute histories globally, reused across rows. The paired seed-7 direct branch is an intervention in that registered random-stream history. Historical fate-model and analytic tests are not pooled with these histories.
scope: Consolidation snapshot; no new scientific simulations. Curated decisions and evidence are separate from the complete directory inventory.

entries.claim: No-feedback development produces strong chemical contrast; full coupling suppresses it in the paired zygote comparison.
entries.limitations: One paired history; formation contrast is not a discrete identity or shape-causality result.

entries.claim: Polar mechanics alone suppresses initiation; removing its mechanical contribution from tension+adhesion restores formation on the matched geometry.
entries.limitations: One mature geometry, two prepared chemical families, twelve continuations; chemical modulation of polarity remains active.

entries.claim: The direct branch loses graph-supported homogeneous instability during development.
entries.limitations: Instantaneous frozen-graph linearization; not a nonlinear-maintenance or moving-system stability proof.

entries.claim: All three histories retain developed chemical contrast and cell association after switching full coupling on; paired keep-off controls also retain it.
entries.limitations: Finite horizon t=90-150 after the 16-cell cap; not direct-feedback formation, continued division, or inherited identity.

entries.claim: Both endpoint graphs in each of the three histories support locally stable uniform and patterned chemical states.
entries.limitations: Six graphs and 252 nested starts are not independent histories; no full moving-system stability or bifurcation classification.

entries.claim: Small perturbations recover on both original graphs; only the no-feedback graph retains strong chemical contrast.
entries.limitations: Two graphs from one paired history; recovery of uniform chemistry is not differentiation.

entries.claim: Among 96 informative chemical transplants, half return and half reorganize; none meets transferred-concentration likeness.
entries.limitations: 120 pairs within one fixed graph; post-run endpoint stability is exploratory, not independent replication.

entries.claim: Isolation erases differences in the tested releases; common reservoir exchange can support multiple stable chemical states.
entries.limitations: 2256 sampled cell states descend from one history; fixed reservoirs supply external support. An initial strength-4 tolerance failure is retained; further refinement passes, with one selected independent Radau check per arm.

entries.claim: An evolving finite reservoir can support differences; formation and release depend on exchange regime.
entries.limitations: Original strong-release numerical failure, unstable symmetric endpoints, and an unsettled follow-up remain exceptions; not new developmental histories.

entries.claim: Exchanged-cell responses favor the donor reference on both endpoint graphs in each history.
entries.limitations: 48 reference comparisons nested in three histories; donor-nearer is not unchanged transfer or autonomous identity.

entries.claim: Each history has eight donor-nearer moving response comparisons; exchanged chemistry reorganizes rather than retaining transferred values unchanged.
entries.limitations: Prepared mature patterned basins; 24 comparisons reuse the same three histories, not new formation or population-frequency evidence.

entries.claim: Conservative neighbor averaging shifts the fresh low-state recipient in all three histories; broader challenges alter late states and pulse responses.
entries.limitations: 36 challenges and 72 comparisons nested in three histories; immediate pulses occur during reorganization; geometry is frozen.

entries.claim: Both selected seed-8 immediate-pulse nonrecoveries recover when challenged after settling, under percentage and original-amount controls; alternative endpoints also resist these pulses.
entries.limitations: Post-selected follow-up of two cases in one reused history; 24 pulses are not a replication rate, a measured delay window, or moving-context evidence.

entries.claim: Four full accepted mature CPU/GPU control/pulse replays pass; additional contexts are checked before scientific use.
entries.limitations: Backend agreement in the tested mature regime, not an extra history, developmental convergence, or GPU division validation.

entries.claim: Both existing histories pass mature exchange/retention and selected same-state response timestep halving; classifications and sampled recoveries agree.
entries.limitations: 18 repeated continuations, four full backend replays, ten context checks; no new history, spatial convergence, or refined development.

entries.claim: The paired t=90-150 seed-7 maintenance continuation passes timestep halving.
entries.limitations: Same physical starts; no validation of preceding cleavage.

entries.claim: Conservative volume-weighted transport converges on the controlled regular reference; random-walk scaling does not give fixed physical diffusivity.
entries.limitations: Regular reference does not validate diffuse-contact conductance closure.

entries.claim: Flat orthogonal reference checks pass; all three declared general-geometry closure checks fail.
entries.limitations: Curvature, diffuse gaps, and nonorthogonal flux remain physical approximation limits.

entries.claim: The separate conservative-positive flux prototype passes its specified patches.
entries.limitations: Not coupled to live mechanics; does not repair the current conductance approximation.

entries.claim: The separate corrected-boundary prototype passes its prescribed patches.
entries.limitations: Not live-integrated; no general moving-tissue acceptance.

entries.claim: The historical full-development refinement completes five cases but fails the combined predeclared gate.
entries.limitations: Historical fate model; not three new attribute-model histories, and no full-development acceptance transferred.

entries.claim: A separate calibrated diagnostic resolves the cleavage measurement failure without rewriting the original failed screen.
entries.limitations: Controlled analytic cleavage, not full developmental or sharp-interface convergence.
